description: This Java source file defines a factory class 'ConciergeEnforcerClusterRouterFactory' for creating an Akka cluster routing actor, specifically a ClusterRouterGroup for the EnforcerActor in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to instantiate a cluster router with specific routing settings and paths.

classes.name: ConciergeEnforcerClusterRouterFactory
classes.description: A final utility class that provides a static method to create a cluster routing ActorRef for the EnforcerActor used in a cluster setting with Akka framework.

methods.name: createConciergeEnforcerClusterRouter
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActorRef for a ClusterRouterGroup configured with a consistent hashing group and specific cluster settings to route messages to EnforcerActor instances across the cluster.
